questions.question: When a user types / in a document, how do the individual block packages add their own entries to that popup menu, and how is the order of the entries decided?
questions.note: extensions.ts registers per-block config extensions, utils.ts merges them and sorts by the group string, the image config shows a block contributing an item

questions.question: How does the editor convert a document to Markdown and back, and how does each block type plug in its own conversion rules?
questions.note: the shared adapter walks the AST and snapshot using registered block matchers, block-adapter.ts defines the matcher extension, the paragraph adapter is a concrete matcher

questions.question: Where are the rules for filtering rows in a table or kanban view implemented, for example text contains or starts with, and where are grouped and/or conditions checked against a row?
questions.note: eval.ts evaluates single filters and and/or groups per row, string.ts defines the text filter functions, types.ts defines the filter tree shape

questions.question: Where do I declare a new experimental feature toggle that shows up in workspace settings, and where is its on or off state saved?
questions.note: constant.ts lists every flag with default state and configurability, flags.ts reads and writes each flag through global state storage

questions.question: How do React components in the app get hold of shared services, and how are services scoped so each workspace or doc gets its own instances?
questions.note: framework.ts registers components per scope, provider.ts resolves them and creates scopes and entities, react/index.tsx exposes hooks and scope providers

questions.question: How does offline search in the browser break text into searchable terms, including Chinese or Japanese text, and how are matching docs scored?
questions.note: tokenizer.ts splits words and uses n-grams for CJK, bm25.ts holds the scoring formula, inverted-index.ts stores terms in IndexedDB and applies the score

questions.question: When I type in a doc that belongs to a cloud workspace, how does the change travel from local storage to the server over the socket and get broadcast to other collaborators?
questions.note: peer.ts queues push and pull jobs between local and remote storage, cloud/doc.ts emits the push over socket.io, gateway.ts handles the push, stores it and broadcasts updates

questions.question: Where does the server verify the proof of work token that desktop and mobile clients send instead of solving the Cloudflare captcha?
questions.note: captcha.rs consumes the stored challenge and checks the stamp, hashcash.rs implements stamp minting and checking, service.ts picks the provider and calls the native runtime

questions.question: How does meeting audio recording in the desktop app move through its states, from detecting a meeting app to importing the finished audio into a doc?
questions.note: the markdown file documents session and import state machines, coordinator.ts persists and transitions recording jobs, feature.ts wires app detection and native capture

questions.question: Where is importing Microsoft OneNote notebooks implemented, and how are the parsed pages handed to the desktop app in batches?
questions.note: onenote/mod.rs parses notebooks into docs and assets, session.rs exposes create and next batch functions to Node, handlers.ts calls them from Electron IPC

questions.question: Where are the tools that the AI chat can call, such as searching workspace docs or the web, defined, and where does the server decide which tools a chat gets?
questions.note: tool-runtime.ts builds the tool set per chat options, tool.ts defines the tool shape and helper, doc-search.ts is an example tool

questions.question: Where is the email that tells someone they were invited to join a workspace written, and where is its subject line set?
questions.note: invitation.tsx is the React email template, index.tsx maps templates to subjects, render.ts renders them to HTML

questions.question: Where are the short names like web, server or desktop that map to full package names for the monorepo helper command defined, and where are they resolved?
questions.note: distribution.ts holds the alias to package map, command.ts validates the argument and resolves the alias to a package

questions.question: How are backend server settings declared with default values, and how can a self-hoster override them with environment variables or a JSON settings file?
questions.note: register.ts defines module config descriptors, reads env overrides and config.json paths, env.ts parses env values, factory.ts loads and validates the final config

questions.question: On the whiteboard canvas, how is the stacking order of shapes and blocks stored, and how does bringing an item to the front or sending it back change it?
questions.note: layer.ts keeps fractional index keys, builds layers and computes reordered indexes, utils/layer.ts compares indexes, more.ts applies front and back actions from the toolbar

questions.question: What happens on the server when a user signs in with an emailed one-time link instead of a password, from requesting the email to clicking the link and getting a session?
questions.note: controller.ts exposes sign-in endpoints, magic-link.ts sends and completes the link via the runtime, login.rs stores the OTP hash, queues the mail and verifies attempts

questions.question: What happens when a user attaches a large file in a cloud workspace, and how does the upload choose between a direct presigned upload, a multipart upload, or sending it through the API?
questions.note: blob-writer.ts starts the upload and follows the method the server returns, resolvers/blob.ts reserves quota and picks the method, wrappers/blob.ts talks to object storage

questions.question: How do I run the backend server locally along with its database and cache services, and which test accounts can I log in with?
questions.note: covers docker compose for postgres, redis and mailhog, native build, init, dev command and the seeded dev, pro and team users

questions.question: Which branch should my pull request target, how must the PR title be formatted, and what has to pass before it can be merged?
questions.note: both describe targeting canary, Conventional Commits titles with allowed scopes, and the CLA, CI and review requirements

questions.question: What are the steps to build and package the Electron desktop app installer, and why do I need to reinstall dependencies with a different yarn setting?
questions.note: explains building native modules and core, reinstalling with hoisting off, and the make commands for Mac, Linux and Windows
